bmad-brainstorming.purpose: Run a structured brainstorming workflow and keep presenting ideation options until the user decides to move on.

bmad-market-research.purpose: Conduct market research and keep the work focused on competition, customers, trends, and evidence-backed findings.

bmad-domain-research.purpose: Conduct domain research and keep the work focused on domain knowledge, terminology, constraints, and industry context.

bmad-technical-research.purpose: Conduct technical research and keep the work focused on feasibility, implementation approaches, and architecture options.

bmad-create-product-brief.purpose: Create a product brief and keep driving toward a concise, decision-ready brief rather than open-ended discussion.

bmad-document-project.purpose: Document the project and keep collecting architecture, component, and source-tree knowledge into usable artifacts.

bmad-party-mode.purpose: Run multi-agent party mode and keep the interaction centered on coordinated viewpoints until the party session is complete.

bmad-create-prd.purpose: Create a PRD and keep gathering and structuring requirements into a complete product requirements document.

bmad-validate-prd.purpose: Validate the PRD and keep the work focused on gaps, quality, cohesion, and implementation readiness.

bmad-edit-prd.purpose: Edit an existing PRD and keep the work focused on targeted updates, not full rediscovery.

bmad-create-epics-and-stories.purpose: Break the approved scope into epics and stories and keep the output implementation-oriented.

bmad-check-implementation-readiness.purpose: Check implementation readiness and keep verifying alignment between PRD, UX, architecture, and stories.

bmad-correct-course.purpose: Run course correction and keep the work focused on diagnosing changes and selecting the best revised path.

bmad-create-architecture.purpose: Create architecture guidance and keep the work focused on technical decisions, tradeoffs, and implementation alignment.

bmad-create-ux-design.purpose: Create UX guidance and keep the work focused on flows, states, and implementation-relevant UX detail.

bmad-sprint-planning.purpose: Run sprint planning and keep the work focused on sequencing, status, and delivery structure.

bmad-create-story.purpose: Create a context-rich implementation story and keep the output detailed enough for the developer workflow.

bmad-retrospective.purpose: Run a retrospective and keep the work focused on lessons, outcomes, and improvement actions.

bmad-dev-story.purpose: Execute a story implementation workflow and keep the work focused on code, tests, and story acceptance criteria.

bmad-code-review.purpose: Run the BMAD code review workflow and keep the work focused on findings, risks, and actionable review output.

bmad-qa-generate-e2e-tests.purpose: Generate QA automation and keep the work focused on practical end-to-end test coverage for existing behavior.

bmad-quick-spec.purpose: Create a quick technical spec and keep the work lean, scoped, and implementation-ready.

bmad-quick-dev.purpose: Execute the quick-dev workflow and keep the work focused on implementing the scoped quick spec end-to-end.
